votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 13 of 2023 Amendment to Terms for Loan to Ville 1659, and Clarification of Housing Development Loan Program
votes.description: Modifies the terms of the Ville 1659 project's Housing Development Loan Program loan at 1659 West North Temple, changing it from a construction gap loan with cash-flow payments to a bridge loan with a balloon payment, reducing the term from 40 years to three years at one percent interest instead of two percent.
